concerns.text: The plan specifies using a Linear Mixed‑Effects Model (LMM) `score ~ method + (1|domain)` for each metric, including Access Control and Forgetting which are binary outcomes. LMM assumes normally distributed residuals, which is violated for binary data; a Generalized Linear Mixed‑Effects Model (e.g., logistic) should be used instead. Continuing with LMM may produce invalid inference.
